name: South Carolina
notes: SC starts from federal taxable income, but did not conform to OBBBA for 2025: the extra $750/$1,500/$1,125 federal standard deduction must be added back, so the pre-OBBBA 2025 amounts (15,000/30,000/15,000/22,500) are used. Conformity legislation (H.3368) was pending in 2026 - verify.
2025 top rate 6.0%. No personal exemption (dependent exemption $4,930 ignored).
H.4216 replaces the structure from tax year 2026 (1.99%/5.21%, SC Income Adjusted Deduction).
